Political map of Africa

55 countries and territories, each colored differently from its neighbors. Western Sahara is shown as its own territory. Dots mark capital cities; the island nations are labeled with a pointer line.

Tap the map to open it full size, then pinch to zoom.Click the map to open it full screen, then scroll to zoom and drag to move.

Borders: Natural Earth (public domain). Capital cities: Natural Earth populated places. Drawn in the Lambert azimuthal equal-area projection. Borders are the internationally recognized ones: Somaliland is shown as part of Somalia, and Western Sahara, whose status the UN has not settled (Morocco administers most of it), is shown as its own territory, as on its country page.
